findings.location: Increments B–C, B step 2 and C step 2
findings.problem: The digest is checked against one recomputed preview, while B explicitly requires the write path to build the release plan again. With no lock or immutable snapshot of `packages/` between those operations, a package can change after digest validation and before the second plan is written, so the command can record approvals for hashes the owner did not confirm.
findings.suggestion: Build one immutable release plan after validating the digest and write records from that exact plan; alternatively lock and revalidate the package inputs immediately before writing. Add a race-oriented test that proves a changed input after preview validation cannot be released.

summary: The plan has a digest-to-write time-of-check/time-of-use gap; it otherwise addresses the prior security-review finding.
